steps.content: The opening performances electrify the atmosphere as the Cristallia gates yawn wide. A tide of bodies surges forward—elbows jab, shoulders collide, and people are inevitably caught in the crush.

steps.speaker: Stylish Woman
steps.content: Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't hurt you, did I? Are you—huh?

steps.speaker: Stylish Woman
steps.content: Wait, how can a little girl like you be here all alone...

steps.speaker: Trembling Girl
steps.content: ...I-I'm fine. Please let go.

steps.speaker: Stylish Woman
steps.content: Hey, a kid like you shouldn't really be wandering alone here...

steps.speaker: Icy Voice
steps.content: Let her go.
Hecate steps up and drives the woman back with her piercing gaze, then silently pulls her trembling companion away.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Still not used to crowded places? I'll contact the Bureau and let them take you back. I can handle it by myself.

steps.speaker: Trembling Girl
steps.content: No!
Elvira's head jerks up suddenly. She catches Hecate's rising hand, warning her in a hushed voice.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...I'm fine, but don't use your power. Don't use Nightmare to search.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: In a place this sensitive, every security department must have agents here. Most people still don't fully trust Sinners, and everyone's already on edge because of the Outlanders. If you use your power without permission and get caught, we'll just end up making everything worse.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Then tell me, where exactly should I look? I can sense Chief's nearby through the shackles, but with this crowd, I can't pinpoint his location.
steps.female_content: Then tell me, where exactly should I look? I can sense Chief's nearby through the shackles, but with this crowd, I can't pinpoint her location.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief hasn't been to the Bureau for three days, but the 9th Agency keeps showing up, with lots of encrypted communications passing through. You said yourself there haven't been any Mania incidents these days. Things are strange.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I asked Nightingale, but she also evaded my questions and even tried to distract me. This is just like what happened during the election. MBCC could have stayed out of it, but they still chose to put Chief in danger. I don't like it.
Her gaze falls upon the flushed, jubilant Max King on the podium.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I know that man. Chief called him a "smart arse," but he said they're friends. And friends should help each other. I'll go ask him.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Don't!

As Max King pivots around, greeting the crowd with waves, his gaze sweeps across the entire venue. For a brief moment, both girls are convinced his eyes lock onto theirs—his smile stuttering mid-glow—but the connection snaps as quickly as it came.
Then, with perfect composure, he shifts his gaze away, laughing as he melts into the crowd of well-dressed attendees, as if all below the stage are complete strangers.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...When people climb that high, they always change.
She has only met him in person once, but the Max King before her now seems an entirely different man. Elvira has changed too—the two people who had always been by her side back then are long gone.
Elvira takes a moment to compose herself, carefully choosing her words.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: In times of real crisis, someone like ${PlayerName} always ends up standing out, given more important roles, moved to higher places you don't know about.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I know this makes you uncomfortable, maybe even lonely and anxious. But I think that person won't change so easily. Bonds that have been deepened don't just break. You should know that better than I do.
Noticing Hecate's continued silence, Elvira gathers her courage and presses on.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Since the shackles work as a two-way connection, I'm sure he also knows you're here. If ${PlayerName} hasn't come to find you despite knowing that, he must be on some secret mission. And...
steps.female_content: Since the shackles work as a two-way connection, I'm sure she also knows you're here. If ${PlayerName} hasn't come to find you despite knowing that, she must be on some secret mission. And...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: He must think this mission is quite safe, at least for now. Otherwise, he'd never let you operate alone. Knowing him, he might even be watching you right now from somewhere.
steps.female_content: She must think this mission is quite safe, at least for now. Otherwise, she'd never let you operate alone. Knowing her, she might even be watching you right now from somewhere.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: For now, just focus on gathering intelligence and learn everything you can about the mission area. By the time you meet up with him, you'll have useful information that can help him.
steps.female_content: For now, just focus on gathering intelligence and learn everything you can about the mission area. By the time you meet up with her, you'll have useful information that can help her.

steps.content: Those final words finally reach the Sinner's heart standing before her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I see.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If it's a secret mission, I shouldn't cause trouble for Chief. Thank you for reminding me. In return...
Hecate reaches out and pulls Elvira's hat lower to conceal her face.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You don't need to be afraid. If someone comes after you, I'll stay in disguise and draw them away from you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You're clever, and you always think ahead. You've helped me a lot. So whether it's for the mission or because I want to say thank you, I won't let anyone hurt you.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Thank you.

A twinge of guilt needles Elvira. She was the one who manipulated Hecate into breaking protocol—using the pretext of "tracking Chief" to reach the Great Expo. Now she stands here, hypocritically playing the role of the cautious one while Hecate offers her sincere gratitude.
...But without doing this, she, "the specially detained daughter of the former Speaker," would likely never have the chance to leave the MBCC.
She has grown tired of being protected, of being confined in some safe house. This is a rare opportunity. And she will get what she wants.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: This is just the area for the public. The Great Expo also has a VIP section where all the important people will be. We should find a way in.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...I want to see these "Outlanders" with my own eyes. See who they really are...
Her gaze skims past the Speaker of DisCity, locking onto the Outland delegation beside him. Without hesitation, she strides forward.
[Scene Change]
The stylish woman watches as the two girls she has just bumped into disappear into the crowd, reflecting on what she has glimpsed during that brief encounter.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: That girl just now...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Her outfit's pretty nice, understated in style but you can tell that fabric's expensive. Definitely custom-made, the kind only rich kids wear. Are those two sisters?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Hmm... why would kids from that kind of family be wandering alone instead of being in the VIP section? Lost, maybe? I was thinking about helping contact their family, but too late now that they're gone...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Ah, whatever. I'm sure the Expo security's got this covered. No need for me to meddle. I should get to work anyway. Duty calls!

She shakes her head, clearing away the distracting thoughts. With her mask and sunglasses removed, Thalia dabs at her makeup with practiced ease. The moment the camera light blinks on, she meets her audience with a bright smile.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Hi there, lovelies! Welcome to Thalia's Great Expo Special! I'll be taking you on a full tour of all the Outland exhibition sections, plus uncovering hidden gems and the most post-worthy spots! Stay close, and don't miss a thing!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Aight now, buckle up. We're jumping right into this Great Expo tour! Hit that follow if you haven't already. You're not gonna wanna miss this!
